newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary offers stake in ore-mining company.
newsitem.headline: Hungary offers stake in ore-mining company.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt said it will publicly offer a 90 percent stake in a one-round tender in Recski Ercbanyak Rt ore-mining company, APV spokesman Adam Dudits told APV's weekly news conference.
The remaining 10 percent will be offered to employees but in case of undersubscription the buyer has to purchase the outstanding shares, he said.
The buyer has to meet several conditions, including reference works on deep-shaft ore-mining and has to outline strategic plans.
The bid, to be submitted on the day of November 4, will be bound for 90 days and the buyer has to pay in cash in one instalment.
The company's registered capital is 8.9 billion forints.
